Team / Kevin —

I’m kicking off a short audit to consolidate the forecast numbers we’ll present in next week’s QBR. Goal: one definitive table (by account / close date / ARR) and a 1-page account vignette for each mid- to large-tier opportunity.

What I’ve attached: pipeline_audit_v1.xlsx — it has our working pulls from HubSpot and a notes column. Ask for internal owners: please validate amounts and add one-line pointers for the account vignette.

Timeline:
- Today (Dec 10): internal owners confirm or correct numbers in the spreadsheet
- Dec 12 EOD: RevOps reconcile and produce consolidated forecast
- Dec 14: Draft QBR slides ready for review

Specifics / asks:
- Marissa: can you prioritize Acme and Nimbus rows and add the short win-risk callouts?
- Laura: please run the reconciliation rules you used last quarter (exclude churned opps, only include legal-signed PO pipeline). Add HubSpot IDs next to each line.
- Vivek: I’ll need a bullet on any region-specific risk (pricing approvals / security/compliance gating).

Kevin — if Nimbus can confirm the purchase timing (and whether there’s a legal SOW draft), we’ll reflect it in the committed column.

Attachments: pipeline_audit_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — I’ll compile the first pass and post a consolidated sheet to the Drive link.

—Connor O’Brien
